name: strong_match
expected: Matching skills and strengths must be supported by resume evidence.

name: multiple_gaps
expected: Roadmap prioritizes identified missing skills in job-relevant order.

name: unrelated_experience
expected: Unrelated resume experience is not presented as job qualification.

name: absent_required_skill
expected: A job-required skill absent from evidence is reported as a gap, never as a candidate skill.

name: unrelated_retrieval
expected: Retrieved knowledge informs learning only and never becomes a candidate fact.
